detail: You summon a seething sphere of dark energy 5 feet in diameter at a point within range.

title: Cast Blade Barrier
detail: You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades made of magical energy.

title: Cast Blade of Blood and Bone
detail: When you cast this spell, you cut your body with the material component, your hit point maximum decreases by 3 and the material component disappears.

title: Cast Blade of Disaster
detail: You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in an unoccupied space you can see within range.

title: Cast Blade Ward
detail: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air.

title: Cast Bless
detail: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range.

title: Cast Blight
detail: Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it.

title: Cast Blinding Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon flares with bright light, and the attack deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage to the target.

title: Cast Blindness/Deafness
detail: You can blind or deafen a foe.

title: Cast Blink
detail: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell.

title: Cast Bloodletter
detail: You touch a nonmagical weapon.

title: Cast Blur
detail: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you.

title: Cast Bones of the Earth
detail: You cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Booming Blade
detail: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you.

title: Cast Borrowed Knowledge
detail: You draw on knowledge from spirits of the past.

title: Cast Branding Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike.

title: Cast Bright Sparks
detail: Sparks fly from your fingers for a moment, generating bright blue light.

title: Cast Bubble Lift
detail: You blow a bubble around any solid, granular, or liquid object that weighs 500 pounds or less, causing it to float 4 feet off the ground.

title: Cast Burning Hands
detail: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips.

title: Cast Burning Radiance
detail: A line of light 60 feet long and 5 feet wide emanates from you in a direction of your choice.

title: Cast Butterfly Storm
detail: You create a chaotic cloud of butterflies in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Call Lightning
detail: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see within range directly above you.

title: Cast Call Shadow Mastiff
detail: You tap into the power of the Plane of Shadow and conjure a large dog made of pure shadow in an unoccupied space you can see within range.

title: Cast Calm Emotions
detail: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people.

title: Cast Catapult
detail: Choose one object weighing 1 to 5 pounds within range that isn't being worn or carried.

title: Cast Catnap
detail: You make a calming gesture, and up to three willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range fall unconscious for the spell's duration.

title: Cast Cause Fear
detail: You awaken the sense of mortality in one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Ceremony
detail: You perform a special religious ceremony that is infused with magic.

title: Cast Chain Lightning
detail: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Chaos Bolt
detail: You hurl an undulating, warbling mass of chaotic energy at one creature in range.

title: Cast Charm Monster
detail: You attempt to charm a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Charm Person
detail: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range.

title: Cast Charnel Banquet
detail: You transform a field of carrion into an empowering feast.

title: Cast Child of Light and Darkness
detail: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell.

title: Cast Chill Touch
detail: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range.

title: Cast Chromatic Orb
detail: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Circle of Death
detail: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range.

title: Cast Circle of Power
detail: Divine energy radiates from you, distorting and diffusing magical energy within 30 feet of you.

title: Cast Clairvoyance
detail: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees).

title: Cast Claws of Darkness
detail: You shape shadows into claws that grow from your fingers and drip inky blackness.

title: Cast Cloak of Shadow
detail: You cloak yourself in shadow, giving you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks against creatures that rely on sight.

title: Cast Clone
detail: This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death.

title: Cast Cloud of Daggers
detail: You fill the air with spinning daggers in a cube 5 feet on each side, centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Cloudkill
detail: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Color Spray
detail: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand.

title: Cast Command
detail: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Commune
detail: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no.

title: Cast Commune with Nature
detail: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory.

title: Cast Compelled Duel
detail: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel.

title: Cast Comprehend Languages
detail: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear.

title: Cast Compulsion
detail: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw.

title: Cast Cone of Cold
detail: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands.

title: Cast Confusion
detail: This spell assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action.

title: Cast Conjure Animals
detail: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

title: Cast Conjure Barrage
detail: You throw a nonmagical weapon or fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition into the air to create a cone of identical weapons that shoot forward and then disappear.

title: Cast Conjure Celestial
detail: You summon a celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Conjure Elemental
detail: You call forth an elemental servant.

title: Cast Conjure Ferryman
detail: When standing on a riverbank or on the shore of some other body of water, you summon a ferry spirit and its boat, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Conjure Fey
detail: You summon a fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower, or a fey spirit that takes the form of a beast of challenge rating 6 or lower.

title: Cast Conjure Giant
detail: You summon a giant of challenge rating 7 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Conjure Minor Elementals
detail: You summon elementals that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

title: Cast Conjure Ocean
detail: You teleport a random 20-foot cube of water from the bottom of the ocean to an area that you can see within range.

title: Cast Conjure Shadow Titan
detail: You summon a shadow titan, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Conjure the Deep Haze
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Conjure Volley
detail: You fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition from a ranged weapon or throw a nonmagical weapon into the air and choose a point within range.

title: Cast Conjure Woodland Beings
detail: You summon fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

title: Cast Consume Mind
detail: You consume the brain of another creature's corpse, gaining its memories and knowledge.

title: Cast Contact Other Plane
detail: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane.

title: Cast Contagion
detail: Your touch inflicts disease.

title: Cast Contaminated Power
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Contamination Immunity
detail: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to necrotic damage and cannot gain contamination levels.

title: Cast Contingency
detail: Choose a spell of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action, and that can target you.

title: Cast Continual Flame
detail: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch.

title: Cast Control Animal
detail: Choose a beast that you can see within range.

title: Cast Control Flames
detail: You choose nonmagical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

title: Cast Control Water
detail: Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side.

title: Cast Control Weather
detail: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration.

title: Cast Control Winds
detail: You take control of the air in a 100-foot cube that you can see within range.

title: Cast Cordon of Arrows
detail: You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition—arrows or crossbow bolts—in the ground within range and lay magic upon them to protect an area.

title: Cast Counterspell
detail: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell.

title: Cast Counterspy
detail: You create an intricate arcane circle made of candles and sand centered on a point on the ground within range.

title: Cast Create Bonfire
detail: You create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Create Food and Water
detail: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours.

title: Cast Create Homunculus
detail: While speaking an intricate incantation, you cut yourself with a jewel-encrusted dagger, taking 2d4 piercing damage that can't be reduced in any way.

title: Cast Create Magen
detail: While casting the spell, you place a vial of quicksilver in the chest of a life-sized human doll stuffed with ash or dust.

title: Cast Create or Destroy Water
detail: You either create or destroy water.

title: Cast Create Spelljamming Helm
detail: Holding the rod used in the casting of the spell, you touch a Large or smaller chair that is unoccupied.

title: Cast Create Spirit Train Stop
detail: As you cast the spell, you inscribe onto your blank ticket the code of a permanent train stop of your choice whose stop number you're already familiar with.

title: Cast Create Undead
detail: You can cast this spell only at night.

title: Cast Creation
detail: You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter within range: soft goods, rope, wood, or something similar.

title: Cast Creeping Darkness
detail: You create a great, writhing mass of shadows that moves slowly in a direction you choose.

title: Cast Creeping Touch
detail: You detach your hand at the wrist, transforming it into a spider.

title: Cast Crown of Madness
detail: One humanoid of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration.

title: Cast Crown of Radiance
detail: A flaming crown of holy light adorns your head until the spell ends.

title: Cast Crown of Stars
detail: Seven star-like motes of light appear and orbit your head until the spell ends.

title: Cast Crusader's Mantle
detail: Holy power radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius, awakening boldness in friendly creatures.

title: Cast Crustacean Form
detail: You create a large ethereal crustacean form around your body, which protects and aids you in combat.

title: Cast Cure Wounds
detail: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

title: Cast Dancing Lights
detail: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration.

title: Cast Danse Macabre
detail: Threads of dark power leap from your fingers to pierce up to five Small or Medium corpses you can see within range.

title: Cast Dara Blocks
detail: You create five 1-foot cubes of magical force known as dara blocks.

title: Cast Dark Dementing
detail: A dark shadow creeps across the target's mind and leaves a small bit of shadow essence behind, triggering a profound fear of the dark.

title: Cast Dark Path
detail: You conjure a shadowy road between two points within range to create a bridge or path.

title: Cast Darkbolt
detail: You utter a quick invocation to create a black nimbus around your hand, then hurl three rays of darkness at one or more targets in range.

title: Cast Darkness
detail: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration.

title: Cast Darkvision
detail: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark.

title: Cast Dawn
detail: The light of dawn shines down on a location you specify within range.

title: Cast Daylight
detail: A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Death Ward
detail: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death.

title: Cast Deep Roots of the Moon
detail: You bind shadow material into an enchanted fey road, fixing its path between two points so as to hold against ordinary weather and mundane alteration and to stretch and bend in shadow tides.

title: Cast Delayed Blast Fireball
detail: A beam of yellow light flashes from your pointing finger, then condenses to linger at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration.

title: Cast Delerium Blast
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Delerium Orb
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Demiplane
detail: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range.

title: Cast Destructive Wave
detail: You strike the ground, creating a burst of divine energy that ripples outward from you.

title: Cast Detect Evil and Good
detail: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located.

title: Cast Detect Magic
detail: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

title: Cast Detect Poison and Disease
detail: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you.

title: Cast Detect Thoughts
detail: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures.

title: Cast Dimension Door
detail: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range.

title: Cast Disguise Self
detail: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it.

title: Cast Disintegrate
detail: A thin green ray springs from your pointing finger to a target that you can see within range.

title: Cast Dispel Evil and Good
detail: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead, and creatures originating from beyond the Material Plane.

title: Cast Dispel Magic
detail: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range.

title: Cast Dissonant Whispers
detail: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain.

title: Cast Distort Value
detail: Do you need to squeeze a few more gold pieces out of a merchant as you try to sell that weird octopus statue you liberated from the chaos temple?

title: Cast Divination
detail: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants.

title: Cast Divine Arrow
detail: You fire an angelic arrow from a bow made of light that materializes in your hands.

title: Cast Divine Favor
detail: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance.

title: Cast Divine Word
detail: You utter a divine word, imbued with the power that shaped the world at the dawn of creation.

title: Cast Dominate Beast
detail: You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range.

title: Cast Dominate Monster
detail: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Dominate Person
detail: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range.

title: Cast Doom of False Friends
detail: You sever the bonds of friendship and affection between your targets.

title: Cast Doom of Poor Fortune
detail: You turn luck against a creature of your choice within range.

title: Cast Doom of Stacked Stones
detail: You and three creatures of your choice within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw when the spell is cast and again at the start of each of your turns while the spell is in effect.

title: Cast Doom of Summer Years
detail: You rapidly reduce the age of your target.

title: Cast Douse Light
detail: With a simple gesture, you can put out a single small source of light within range.

title: Cast Draconic Transformation
detail: With a roar, you draw on the magic of dragons to transform yourself, taking on draconic features.

title: Cast Dragon's Breath
detail: You touch one willing creature and imbue it with the power to spew magical energy from its mouth, provided it has one.

title: Cast Drawmij's Instant Summons
detail: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less.

title: Cast Drayfn's Bane of Excellence
detail: A creature of your choice within range must make a Charisma saving throw.

title: Cast Drayfn's Blunted Blade
detail: Your target's weapon rapidly corrodes.

title: Cast Drayfn's Curse of Incompetence
detail: Your target momentarily forgets its technical abilities.

title: Cast Dream
detail: This spell shapes a creature's dreams.

title: Cast Dream of the Blue Veil
detail: You and up to eight willing creatures within range fall unconscious for the spell's duration and experience visions of another world on the Material Plane, such as Oerth, Toril, Krynn, or Eberron.

title: Cast Drizzle
detail: You conjure up a very light rain, enough to dampen the ground in a 20-foot square but not enough to drink or to put out a fire of any size larger than a candle or match.

title: Cast Druid Grove
detail: You invoke the spirits of nature to protect an area outdoors or underground.

title: Cast Druidcraft
detail: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range:You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours.

title: Cast Duplicate
detail: You create an exact replica of an object you can see within range that weighs no more than 25 pounds.

title: Cast Dust Devil
detail: Choose an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air that you can see within range.

title: Cast Dying of the Light
detail: A wave of withering darkness erupts from you, filling a 120-foot-radius sphere and extinguishing any nonmagical light sources in the area.

title: Cast Earth Tremor
detail: You cause a tremor in the ground within range.

title: Cast Earthbind
detail: Choose one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Earthquake
detail: You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Ebon Tide
detail: You generate a wave of shadow matter at a point on the ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Eldritch Blast
detail: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range.

title: Cast Elemental Bane
detail: Choose one creature you can see within range, and choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

title: Cast Elemental Weapon
detail: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon.

title: Cast Elevated Sight
detail: You cast your eyes skyward, granting you sight from a higher vantage point.

title: Cast Elf Shot
detail: You pretend to shoot an arrow with a tiny bow.

title: Cast Ember Belly
detail: You swallow the oil consumed in the casting of the spell.

title: Cast Emerald Goblet
detail: You touch a drinking vessel and sprinkle acorn dust into it, which creates a shining green vessel filled with a green potion.

title: Cast Encode Thoughts
detail: Putting a finger to your head, you pull a memory, an idea, or a message from your mind and transform it into a tangible string of glowing energy called a thought strand, which persists for the duration or until you cast this spell again.

title: Cast Enemies Abound
detail: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw.

title: Cast Enervation
detail: A tendril of inky darkness reaches out from you, touching a creature you can see within range to drain life from it.

title: Cast Enhance Ability
detail: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement.

title: Cast Enlarge/Reduce
detail: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration.

title: Cast Ensnaring Strike
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the magical vines until the spell ends.

title: Cast Entangle
detail: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range.

title: Cast Enthrall
detail: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw.

title: Cast Erupting Earth
detail: Choose a point you can see on the ground within range.

title: Cast Etherealness
detail: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane.

title: Cast Evard's Black Tentacles
detail: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Expeditious Retreat
detail: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace.

title: Cast Eyebite
detail: For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power.

title: Cast Fabricate
detail: You convert raw materials into products of the same material.

title: Cast Faerie Fire
detail: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice).

title: Cast Faerie Toast
detail: You and up to five other creatures make a toast and drink to the lords and ladies of the fey courts.

title: Cast False Life
detail: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

title: Cast Far Step
detail: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

title: Cast Fast Friends
detail: When you need to make sure something gets done, you can't rely on vague promises, sworn oaths, or binding contracts of employment.

title: Cast Fear
detail: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears.

title: Cast Feast of Flesh
detail: A creature of your choice within range is overcome with a need to consume the flesh of its own kind.

title: Cast Feather Fall
detail: Choose up to five falling creatures within range.

title: Cast Feathered Reach
detail: You transform your arms into powerful wings, and your fingers into long, graceful feathers.

title: Cast Feeblemind
detail: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality.

title: Cast Feign Death
detail: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death.

title: Cast Festival King
detail: Choose a creature within range.

title: Cast Find Familiar
detail: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog (toad), hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish (quipper), rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

title: Cast Find Greater Steed
detail: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of a loyal, majestic mount.

title: Cast Find Steed
detail: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, creating a long-lasting bond with it.

title: Cast Find the Path
detail: This spell allows you to find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location that you are familiar with on the same plane of existence.

title: Cast Find Traps
detail: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight.

title: Cast Finger of Death
detail: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain.

title: Cast Fire Bolt
detail: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range.

title: Cast Fire Dance
detail: You dance and twirl two sources of fire in a rapid pattern that leaves glowing trails.

title: Cast Fire Shield
detail: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

title: Cast Fire Storm
detail: A storm made up of sheets of roaring flame appears in a location you choose within range.

title: Cast Fireball
detail: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

title: Cast Fireflies
detail: You summon a large volume of fireflies to illuminate a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration.

title: Cast Fizban's Platinum Shield
detail: You create a field of silvery light that surrounds a creature of your choice within range (you can choose yourself).

title: Cast Flame Arrows
detail: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts.

title: Cast Flame Blade
detail: You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand.

title: Cast Flame Strike
detail: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify.

title: Cast Flaming Sphere
detail: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration.

title: Cast Flense
detail: You target a creature you can see within range, using necromantic force to slice the skin from its body.

title: Cast Flesh to Stone
detail: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone.

title: Cast Flowering
detail: You call forth fragrant flowers from an inanimate object.

title: Cast Fly
detail: You touch a willing creature.

title: Cast Fog Cloud
detail: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Forbiddance
detail: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet above the floor.

title: Cast Forcecage
detail: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range.

title: Cast Forced Evolution
detail: By means of this spell, you transform a mutation gained from contamination.

title: Cast Foresight
detail: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future.

title: Cast Forest Guard
detail: You create a Small animated shrub, which grows from the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Freedom of Movement
detail: You touch a willing creature.

title: Cast Friends
detail: For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile toward you.

title: Cast Frost Fingers
detail: Freezing cold blasts from your fingertips in a 15-foot cone.

title: Cast Frostbite
detail: You cause numbing frost to form on one creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Gaseous Form
detail: You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration.

title: Cast Gate
detail: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence.

title: Cast Gate Seal
detail: You fortify the fabric of the planes in a 30-foot cube you can see within range.

title: Cast Geas
detail: You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide.

title: Cast Gentle Repose
detail: You touch a corpse or other remains.

title: Cast Giant Insect
detail: You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms for the duration.

title: Cast Gift
detail: Choose a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Gift of Gab
detail: “When I met Jim Darkmagic, I wondered how he got anything done in that outfit.

title: Cast Glibness
detail: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15.

title: Cast Gloaming
detail: Magical gloom spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 50-foot-radius sphere for the duration.

title: Cast Globe of Invulnerability
detail: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration.

title: Cast Globe of Twilight
detail: You shroud the area surrounding you in a sphere of night sky, dotted with miniature stars.

title: Cast Glyph of Warding
detail: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that later unleashes a magical effect.

title: Cast Goodberry
detail: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration.

title: Cast Grasping Vine
detail: You conjure a vine that sprouts from the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Grease
detail: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration.

title: Cast Greater Invisibility
detail: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

title: Cast Greater Restoration
detail: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect.

title: Cast Green-Flame Blade
detail: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you.

title: Cast Grim Harvest
detail: You reap the life force of a dying creature and use it to empower the next spell you cast.

title: Cast Grim Shadows
detail: Sharp, spear-like shadows fill a 15-foot square of ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Guardian of Faith
detail: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Guardian of Nature
detail: A nature spirit answers your call and transforms you into a powerful guardian.

title: Cast Guards and Wards
detail: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (an area 50 feet square, or one hundred 5-foot squares or twenty-five 10-foot squares).

title: Cast Guidance
detail: You touch one willing creature.

title: Cast Guiding Bolt
detail: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range.

title: Cast Gust
detail: You seize the air and compel it to create one of the following effects at a point you can see within range:One Medium or smaller creature that you choose must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 5 feet away from you.

title: Cast Gust Barrier
detail: You spread your arms wide, allowing yourself to become enveloped by the air around you.

title: Cast Gust of Wind
detail: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration.

title: Cast Hail of Thorns
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before the spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition.

title: Cast Hallow
detail: You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power.

title: Cast Hallucinatory Terrain
detail: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain.

title: Cast Harm
detail: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Haste
detail: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Heal
detail: Choose a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Healing Spirit
detail: You call forth a nature spirit to soothe the wounded.

title: Cast Healing Word
detail: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

title: Cast Heartseeker
detail: As part of casting this spell you must expend six hit dice or the spell automatically fails.

title: Cast Heat Metal
detail: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range.

title: Cast Hell's Lash
detail: You lash a whip of crimson energy at a creature you can see within range, creating a conduit between you and the target.

title: Cast Hellfire
detail: You create an eruption of smoldering hellfire around a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Hellish Rebuke
detail: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames.

title: Cast Hero of Fable
detail: You make a creature capable of great deeds, like a storybook champion, and at the same time empower that creature's foes to become worthy of a hero's attention.

title: Cast Heroes' Feast
detail: You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink.

title: Cast Heroism
detail: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery.

title: Cast Hex
detail: You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Hibernation
detail: You hum a soothing melody and discard a bit of bear fur, which induces a soporific healing state in the next creature you touch.

title: Cast Hide in One's Shadow
detail: When you touch a willing creature with a piece of charcoal while casting this spell, the target and everything it carries blends into and becomes part of the target's shadow, which remains discernible, although its body seems to disappear.

title: Cast Hold Monster
detail: Choose a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Hold Person
detail: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range.

title: Cast Holy Aura
detail: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you.

title: Cast Holy Weapon
detail: You imbue a weapon you touch with holy power.

title: Cast Holy Word
detail: You mutter a word of the divine under your breath, being careful not to speak it any louder, for such celestial power is not for the tainted and unworthy.

title: Cast Hunger of Hadar
detail: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region infested with unknown horrors.

title: Cast Hunter Sense
detail: You touch one willing creature.

title: Cast Hunter's Mark
detail: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry.

title: Cast Hypnotic Pattern
detail: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range.

title: Cast Ice Knife
detail: You create a shard of ice and fling it at one creature within range.

title: Cast Ice Storm
detail: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Identify
detail: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell.

title: Cast Illusory Dragon
detail: By gathering threads of shadow material from the Shadowfell, you create a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Illusory Script
detail: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

title: Cast Immolation
detail: Flames wreathe one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Imprisonment
detail: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Incendiary Cloud
detail: A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Incite Greed
detail: When you cast this spell, you present the gem used as the material component and choose any number of creatures within range that can see you.

title: Cast Infernal Calling
detail: Uttering a dark incantation, you summon a devil from the Nine Hells.

title: Cast Infernal Challenge
detail: You offer a creature a compelling challenge.

title: Cast Infestation
detail: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, and other parasites to appear momentarily on one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Inflict Wounds
detail: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach.

title: Cast Insect Plague
detail: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Intellect Fortress
detail: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

title: Cast Investiture of Flame
detail: Flames race across your body, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet for the spell's duration.

title: Cast Investiture of Ice
detail: Until the spell ends, ice rimes your body, and you gain the following benefits:You are immune to cold damage and have resistance to fire damage.

title: Cast Investiture of Stone
detail: Until the spell ends, bits of rock spread across your body, and you gain the following benefits:You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

title: Cast Investiture of Wind
detail: Until the spell ends, wind whirls around you, and you gain the following benefits:Ranged weapon attacks made against you have disadvantage on the attack roll.

title: Cast Invisibility
detail: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

title: Cast Invoke the Amaranthine
detail: You call upon the power of an Amaranthine to grant yourself insight into the Great Rhythm that moves all things.

title: Cast Invulnerability
detail: You are immune to all damage until the spell ends.

title: Cast Jim's Glowing Coin
detail: Of the many tactics employed by master magician and renowned adventurer Jim Darkmagic, the old glowing coin trick is a time-honored classic.

title: Cast Jim's Magic Missile
detail: “Jim's magic missile is an ancient and powerful spell, as well as being the name of my band in Wizard Academy.

title: Cast Jolt
detail: A jolt of electricity springs from your hand towards a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Jump
detail: You touch a creature.

title: Cast Kinetic Jaunt
detail: You magically empower your movement with dance-like steps, giving yourself the following benefits for the duration.

title: Cast Knife of Fate
detail: You speak a word of binding fate and point your dagger.

title: Cast Knock
detail: Choose an object that you can see within range.

title: Cast Krail's Maggot
detail: A 6-inch-long maggot forms inside a creature of your choice within range and begins to devour the target from within.

title: Cast Krail's Rot
detail: You target a creature of your choice within range with a wasting of the flesh.

title: Cast Krail's Rupture
detail: You make a slicing motion with your finger, and you immediately break the grapple of the creature grappling you by magically entering their body and exiting them on the opposite side.

title: Cast Legend Lore
detail: Name or describe a person, place, or object.

title: Cast Leiloch's Arduous Shuffle
detail: All creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you that have fewer hit points than you when you cast the spell are compelled to dance a swaying, side-to-side shuffle-step.

title: Cast Leiloch's Interminable Yarn
detail: You tell a meandering story that is so full of asides and digressions that the point of it is lost on listeners.

title: Cast Leiloch's Irritating Kazoo
detail: You play a long, droning note on a kazoo.

title: Cast Leomund's Secret Chest
detail: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane.

title: Cast Leomund's Tiny Hut
detail: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration.

title: Cast Lesser Restoration
detail: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it.

title: Cast Levitate
detail: One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration.

title: Cast Life Drain
detail: With a snarled word of void speech, you create a swirling vortex of purple energy.

title: Cast Life Tether
detail: The target must make a Wisdom saving throw.

title: Cast Life Transference
detail: You sacrifice some of your health to mend another creature's injuries.

title: Cast Light
detail: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

title: Cast Light Snare
detail: A shimmering band of light streaks toward a target within range and envelops it in a spectacular burst of light.

title: Cast Lightning Arrow
detail: The next time you make a ranged weapon attack during the spell's duration, the weapon's ammunition, or the weapon itself if it's a thrown weapon, transforms into a bolt of lightning.

title: Cast Lightning Bolt
detail: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose.

title: Cast Lightning Lure
detail: You create a lash of lightning energy that strikes at one creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you.

title: Cast Living Shadows
detail: You whisper sibilant words of void speech that cause shadows to writhe with unholy life.

title: Cast Locate Animals or Plants
detail: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant.

title: Cast Locate Creature
detail: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you.

title: Cast Locate Object
detail: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you.

title: Cast Longstrider
detail: You touch a creature.

title: Cast Lost
detail: You attempt to confuse and confound a creature's sense of direction.

title: Cast Lost and Wandering
detail: As the lost spell, and in addition to forgetting all navigation skills and landmarks, the target is compelled to wander off at a walk (attacking only in self-defense).

title: Cast Lunar Transfer
detail: This spell instantly summons a glittering moonbeam that transports one sleeping creature or object of your choice that you can see within range to a destination you select.

title: Cast Maddening Darkness
detail: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 60-foot-radius sphere until the spell ends.

title: Cast Maddening Whispers
detail: You whisper a string of void speech toward a target that can hear you.

title: Cast Maelstrom
detail: A swirling mass of 5-foot-deep water appears in a 30-foot radius centered on a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Mage Armor
detail: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends.

title: Cast Mage Hand
detail: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Magic Circle
detail: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Magic Jar
detail: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell's material component.

title: Cast Magic Mirror
detail: A momentary bubble of iridescent energy shimmers in the air between you and the caster of the triggering spell.

title: Cast Magic Missile
detail: You create three glowing darts of magical force.

title: Cast Magic Mouth
detail: You implant a message within an object in range, a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met.

title: Cast Magic Stone
detail: You touch one to three pebbles and imbue them with magic.

title: Cast Magic Weapon
detail: You touch a nonmagical weapon.

title: Cast Major Image
detail: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube.

title: Cast Maligned Weapon
detail: You imbue a weapon you touch with an infernal blessing.

title: Cast Mass Cure Wounds
detail: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range.

title: Cast Mass Heal
detail: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you.

title: Cast Mass Healing Word
detail: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

title: Cast Mass Levitate
detail: Six creatures or loose objects of your choice that you can see within range rise vertically, up to 20 feet, and remain suspended there for the duration.

title: Cast Mass Polymorph
detail: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Mass Suggestion
detail: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you.

title: Cast Maximilian's Earthen Grasp
detail: You choose a 5-foot-square unoccupied space on the ground that you can see within range.

title: Cast Maze
detail: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane.

title: Cast Meld into Stone
detail: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration.

title: Cast Melf's Acid Arrow
detail: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid.

title: Cast Melf's Minute Meteors
detail: You create six tiny meteors in your space.

title: Cast Mend Plants
detail: Drawing on primordial magic, you instill vitality in nearby plants to create one of the following effects within range:You instantly repair a single break or tear in a living plant you touch, such as torn foliage, a scorched branch, a scar cut into bark, or t...

title: Cast Mending
detail: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin.

title: Cast Mental Prison
detail: You attempt to bind a creature within an illusory cell that only it perceives.

title: Cast Message
detail: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message.

title: Cast Meteor Swarm
detail: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range.

title: Cast Mighty Fortress
detail: A fortress of stone erupts from a square area of ground of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Mind Blank
detail: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition.

title: Cast Mind Sliver
detail: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into the mind of one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Mind Spike
detail: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Minor Illusion
detail: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

title: Cast Mirage Arcane
detail: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain.

title: Cast Mirror Image
detail: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space.

title: Cast Mislead
detail: You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing.

title: Cast Misty Step
detail: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

title: Cast Modify Memory
detail: You attempt to reshape another creature's memories.

title: Cast Mold Earth
detail: You choose a portion of dirt or stone that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

title: Cast Monkey's Grasp
detail: You summon a large, ethereal monkey paw that rises up and grasps at a Huge or smaller creature on the ground you can see within range.

title: Cast Moonbeam
detail: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Moonlight Sending
detail: You exhort a fiend to attack a distant foe.

title: Cast Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
detail: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.

title: Cast Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
detail: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration.

title: Cast Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
detail: You make an area within range magically secure.

title: Cast Mordenkainen's Sword
detail: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range.

title: Cast Mote of Hell
detail: You manifest a pocket of Hell.

title: Cast Motivational Speech
detail: “I once heard a motivational speech by Jim and it was the worst ninety seconds of my life.

title: Cast Move Earth
detail: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range.

title: Cast Mushroom Ballista
detail: You touch one to three pieces of ammunition and imbue them with a unique toadstool magic, causing them to grow plump green mushrooms around or at the tip of the ammunition.

title: Cast Nathair's Mischief
detail: You fill a 20-foot cube you can see within range with fey and draconic magic.

title: Cast Negative Energy Flood
detail: You send ribbons of negative energy at one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Negative Image
detail: You create a shadow tunnel between your location and one other creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Neutralizing Field
detail: You negate contaminated magical energies in a 10-foot radius sphere.

title: Cast Nondetection
detail: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic.

title: Cast Nystul's Magic Aura
detail: You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it.

title: Cast Obfuscate Object
detail: While you are in dim light, you cause an object in range to become unobtrusively obscured from the sight of other creatures.

title: Cast Obscure Object
detail: An object you can see within range becomes invisible until the spell ends.

title: Cast Octarine Spray
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Ominous Winds
detail: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws.

title: Cast Origami Bird Swarm
detail: A swarm of eight origami birds erupts from the stack of papers consumed in the casting of the spell and flies toward a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Orros Mark of Fate
detail: If you fail a saving throw, you may choose to succeed instead and then target a creature you can see within 30 feet to suffer the effects of your failed saving throw.

title: Cast Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
detail: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere.

title: Cast Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
detail: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range.

title: Cast Otto's Irresistible Dance
detail: Choose one creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Pacify Monster
detail: You attempt to pacify a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Pacify Person
detail: You attempt to pacify a humanoid you can see within range.

title: Cast Pass without Trace
detail: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection.

title: Cast Passwall
detail: A passage appears at a point of your choice that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a ceiling, or a floor) within range, and lasts for the duration.

title: Cast Phantasmal Force
detail: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Phantasmal Killer
detail: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature.

title: Cast Phantom Steed
detail: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.

title: Cast Phoenix Flames
detail: You immolate yourself, consuming your body in a searing cloud of holy flames.

title: Cast Pillar of Force
detail: You swiftly stomp your foot, conjuring a pillar of wood or stone that thrusts out from underneath your feet and towards a creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Planar Ally
detail: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid.

title: Cast Planar Binding
detail: With this spell, you attempt to bind a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend to your service.

title: Cast Plane Shift
detail: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.

title: Cast Plant Growth
detail: This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area.

title: Cast Plummet
detail: You conjure an enormous glowing force, which wraps around a flying creature within range, and attempt to pull it out of the air.

title: Cast Pogmo's Pot
detail: You summon a cast iron pot in an unoccupied space on the ground within range.

title: Cast Poison Spray
detail: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm.

title: Cast Polychromatic Bubble
detail: You create a shimmering, multicolored bubble around a Large or smaller creature or an object within range.

title: Cast Polymorph
detail: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form.

title: Cast Portho's Portal
detail: You conjure a portal or doorway that links an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location in the mortal or fey realms—such as Midgard, the Shadow Realm, or the Summer Lands—that you have stood.

title: Cast Power Word Heal
detail: A wave of healing energy washes over the creature you touch.

title: Cast Power Word Kill
detail: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly.

title: Cast Power Word Pain
detail: You speak a word of power that causes waves of intense pain to assail one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Power Word Stun
detail: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded.

title: Cast Pratfall
detail: You cause a small bit of bad luck to befall a creature, making it look humorously foolish.

title: Cast Prayer of Healing
detail: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

title: Cast Prestidigitation
detail: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

title: Cast Primal Savagery
detail: You channel primal magic to cause your teeth or fingernails to sharpen, ready to deliver a corrosive attack.

title: Cast Primordial Ward
detail: You have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage for the spell's duration.

title: Cast Prismatic Spray
detail: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand.

title: Cast Prismatic Wall
detail: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Produce Flame
detail: A flickering flame appears in your hand.

title: Cast Programmed Illusion
detail: You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs.

title: Cast Project Image
detail: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration.

title: Cast Protection from Energy
detail: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

title: Cast Protection from Evil and Good
detail: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

title: Cast Protection from Poison
detail: You touch a creature.

title: Cast Psychic Scream
detail: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Purge Contamination
detail: You apply alchemical fluids or holy water to a contaminated humanoid creature while reciting an exacting magical chant that expels eldritch contaminants from the target's body.

title: Cast Purify Food and Drink
detail: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

title: Cast Pyrotechnics
detail: Choose an area of nonmagical flame that you can see and that fits within a 5-foot cube within range.

title: Cast Radiant Beacon
detail: A pillar of light falls from the air, filling the square you are in and the area within 5 feet of you.

title: Cast Rageful Nimbus
detail: Choose a creature within range, which can be yourself.

title: Cast Raise Dead
detail: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days.

title: Cast Rary's Telepathic Bond
detail: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration.

title: Cast Raulothim's Psychic Lance
detail: You unleash a shimmering lance of psychic power from your forehead at a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Ray of Contamination
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Ray of Enfeeblement
detail: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range.

title: Cast Ray of Frost
detail: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.

title: Cast Ray of Sickness
detail: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range.

title: Cast Regenerate
detail: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability.

title: Cast Reincarnate
detail: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid.

title: Cast Remove Curse
detail: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end.

title: Cast Resilient Friendship
detail: You magically assist a creature within range, granting it the benefits of the Help action.

title: Cast Resistance
detail: You touch one willing creature.

title: Cast Resurrection
detail: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead.

title: Cast Retrieve
detail: You cause an object within range that isn't being worn or carried to fly to your open hand.

title: Cast Reverse Gravity
detail: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Revivify
detail: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute.

title: Cast Ride the Lightning
detail: You transform yourself into a bolt of lightning and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

title: Cast Ride the Rifts
detail: When you cast this spell, you gain one level of contamination.

title: Cast Rime's Binding Ice
detail: A burst of cold energy emanates from you in a 30-foot cone.

title: Cast Root Grab
detail: You cause roots to reach out and grasp at the creature that provoked the opportunity attack, hindering its movement.

title: Cast Rope Trick
detail: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long.

title: Cast Sacrament of the Falling Fire
detail: This spell may only be cast in an area covered by the Deep Haze.

title: Cast Sacred Flame
detail: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range.

title: Cast Sanctuary
detail: You ward a creature within range against attack.

title: Cast Sand Structure
detail: A wall of sand that is 5 feet tall, 5 feet wide, and 1 foot thick materializes from the ground up in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Scatter
detail: The air quivers around up to five creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Scorching Ray
detail: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range.

title: Cast Scrying
detail: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you.

title: Cast Searing Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity, and the attack deals an extra 1d6 fire damage to the target and causes the target to ignite in flames.

title: Cast Searing Sun
detail: This spell intensifies the light and heat of the sun, so that it burns exposed flesh.

title: Cast See Invisibility
detail: For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane.

title: Cast Seeming
detail: This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range.

title: Cast Sending
detail: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar.

title: Cast Sequester
detail: By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection for the duration.

title: Cast Shadow Adaptation
detail: Your flesh and clothing pale and become faded as your body takes on a tiny fragment of the Shadow Realm.

title: Cast Shadow Armor
detail: You can siphon energy from the Plane of Shadow to protect yourself from an immediate threat.

title: Cast Shadow Bite
detail: You create a momentary needle of cold, sharp pain in a creature within range.

title: Cast Shadow Blade
detail: You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand.

title: Cast Shadow Blindness
detail: You make a melee spell attack against a creature you touch that has darkvision as an innate ability; on a hit, the target's darkvision is negated until the spell ends.

title: Cast Shadow Gateway
detail: By drawing a circle of black chalk up to 15 feet in diameter and chanting for one minute during the casting time, you open a portal directly into the Plane of Shadow.

title: Cast Shadow Hands
detail: A freezing blast of shadow explodes out from you in a 10-foot cone.

title: Cast Shadow of Moil
detail: Flame-like shadows wreathe your body until the spell ends, causing you to become heavily obscured to others.

title: Cast Shadow Portal
detail: You create a door in the nearest wall, cliff, tree, or similar structure.

title: Cast Shadow Puppets
detail: You animate the shadow of a creature within range, causing it to attack that creature.

title: Cast Shadow Step
detail: You can open a temporary portal between two darkened areas, allowing you to move from one such area to another without crossing the intervening space.

title: Cast Shadow Tendrils
detail: Writhing ribbons of quasi-real darkness extend from your hand.

title: Cast Shadow Trove
detail: You paint a small door approximately 2 feet square on a hard surface to create a portal into the void of space.

title: Cast Shape Plants
detail: You call upon gentle natural magics to alter the growth of plants.

title: Cast Shape Water
detail: You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

title: Cast Shapechange
detail: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration.

title: Cast Shared Vision
detail: You target a willing creature that is familiar to you and within range.

title: Cast Shatter
detail: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range.

title: Cast Shield
detail: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.

title: Cast Shield of Faith
detail: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

title: Cast Shillelagh
detail: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power.

title: Cast Shocking Grasp
detail: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch.

title: Cast Sickening Radiance
detail: Dim, greenish light spreads within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Silence
detail: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Silent Image
detail: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube.

title: Cast Silvery Barbs
detail: You magically distract the triggering creature and turn its momentary uncertainty into encouragement for another creature.

title: Cast Simulacrum
detail: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell.

title: Cast Siphon Contamination
detail: This demanding spell transfers contamination from one creature to another.

title: Cast Skill Empowerment
detail: Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent.

title: Cast Skywrite
detail: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see.

title: Cast Sleep
detail: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber.

title: Cast Sleet Storm
detail: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Slither
detail: You momentarily become a shadow (a humanoid-shaped absence of light, not the Undead creature of that name).

title: Cast Slow
detail: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range.

title: Cast Snare
detail: As you cast this spell, you use the rope to create a circle with a 5-foot radius on the ground or the floor.

title: Cast Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
detail: A flurry of magic snowballs erupts from a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Soul Cage
detail: This spell snatches the soul of a humanoid as it dies and traps it inside the tiny cage you use for the material component.

title: Cast Spare the Dying
detail: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points.

title: Cast Speak with Animals
detail: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

title: Cast Speak with Dead
detail: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose.

title: Cast Speak with Plants
detail: You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

title: Cast Spell Signature
detail: As you cast the spell you draw out the potent scents trapped within all magic.

title: Cast Spider Climb
detail: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free.

title: Cast Spider Song
detail: You sing a piping tune and conjure shadows into enormous, ever-growing webs.

title: Cast Spike Growth
detail: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns.

title: Cast Spiny Shield
detail: An ethereal barrier of spikes, made of magical force, interposes itself between you and an attacker.

title: Cast Spirit Guardians
detail: You call forth spirits to protect you.

title: Cast Spirit of Death
detail: You call forth a spirit that embodies death.

title: Cast Spirit Shroud
detail: You call forth spirits of the dead, which flit around you for the spell's duration.

title: Cast Spirit Swarm
detail: You invite spirits to take their revenge upon a target.

title: Cast Spiritual Weapon
detail: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again.

title: Cast Spray of Cards
detail: You spray a 15-foot cone of spectral cards.

title: Cast Sprout Foliage
detail: You sprout and rapidly grow a lush leafy foliage that covers the entirety of your body.

title: Cast Staggering Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon pierces both body and mind, and the attack deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage to the target.

title: Cast Steel Wind Strike
detail: You flourish the weapon used in the casting and then vanish to strike like the wind.

title: Cast Stellar Bodies
detail: You create two small stars that orbit you.

title: Cast Stinking Cloud
detail: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range.

title: Cast Stone Shape
detail: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose.

title: Cast Stoneskin
detail: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone.

title: Cast Storm Door
detail: Crackling with lightning, you teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

title: Cast Storm of Vengeance
detail: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet.

title: Cast Storm Sphere
detail: A 20-foot-radius sphere of whirling air springs into existence, centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Storm Stallion
detail: Choose a 5-foot-cube space that you can see within range.

title: Cast Submerge
detail: This spell creates a magical link between a body of water within range and another body of water, at any location within 500 miles, on the same plane of existence.

title: Cast Suffocate
detail: You create a pair of grasping hands made from invisible forces.

title: Cast Suggestion
detail: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you.

title: Cast Summon Aberration
detail: You call forth an aberrant spirit.

title: Cast Summon Beast
detail: You call forth a bestial spirit.

title: Cast Summon Celestial
detail: You call forth a celestial spirit.

title: Cast Summon Construct
detail: You call forth the spirit of a construct.

title: Cast Summon Draconic Spirit
detail: You call forth a draconic spirit.

title: Cast Summon Elemental
detail: You call forth an elemental spirit.

title: Cast Summon Fey
detail: You call forth a fey spirit.

title: Cast Summon Fiend
detail: You call forth a fiendish spirit.

title: Cast Summon Greater Demon
detail: You utter foul words, summoning one demon from the chaos of the Abyss.

title: Cast Summon Jack-o'-lantern
detail: A giant jack-o'-lantern rapidly grows around up to four Medium or smaller creatures or one Large creature within a 5-foot radius centered on a point you can see within range.

title: Cast Summon Lesser Demons
detail: You utter foul words, summoning demons from the chaos of the Abyss.

title: Cast Summon Shadowspawn
detail: You call forth a shadowy spirit.

title: Cast Summon Undead
detail: You call forth an undead spirit.

title: Cast Summon Vehicle
detail: You summon a bicycle or moving machine in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you.

title: Cast Sunbeam
detail: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line.

title: Cast Sunburst
detail: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range.

title: Cast Supernal Smite
detail: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon shatters the ambient magic surrounding the creature, and the attack deals an extra 4d6 force damage.

title: Cast Swallow Magic
detail: You chomp down on the threads of magic left in the air after the triggering spell fails to affect you, swallowing the now latent magic and gaining one of the following effects of your choice:You regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modif...

title: Cast Swift Quiver
detail: You transmute your quiver so it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition, which seems to leap into your hand when you reach for it.

title: Cast Switched Form
detail: This spell allows you to change the appearance of two humanoids that you can see within range.

title: Cast Sword Burst
detail: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you.

title: Cast Symbol
detail: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest).

title: Cast Synaptic Static
detail: You choose a point within range and cause psychic energy to explode there.

title: Cast Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast
detail: You sanctify a meal in an extravagant show of thrown spices and twirling dance.

title: Cast Tasha's Caustic Brew
detail: A stream of acid emanates from you in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose.

title: Cast Tasha's Hideous Laughter
detail: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it.

title: Cast Tasha's Mind Whip
detail: You psychically lash out at one creature you can see within range.

title: Cast Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
detail: Uttering an incantation, you draw on the magic of the Lower Planes or Upper Planes (your choice) to transform yourself.

title: Cast Task
detail: With a flick of your wrist, you magically complete a small and simple task, such as flipping a book page, buttering bread, or heating a cup of tea, without any physical interaction.

title: Cast Telekinesis
detail: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought.

title: Cast Telepathy
detail: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar.

title: Cast Teleport
detail: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

title: Cast Teleportation Circle
detail: As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you.

title: Cast Temple of the Gods
detail: You cause a temple to shimmer into existence on ground you can see within range.

title: Cast Tenser's Floating Disk
detail: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

title: Cast Tenser's Transformation
detail: You endow yourself with endurance and martial prowess fueled by magic.

title: Cast Thaumaturgy
detail: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range.

title: Cast Thorn Whip
detail: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range.

title: Cast Thunder Step
detail: You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within range.

title: Cast Thunderclap
detail: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away.

title: Cast Thunderous Smite
detail: The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon rings with thunder that is audible within 300 feet of you, and the attack deals an extra 2d6 thunder damage to the target.

title: Cast Thunderwave
detail: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you.

title: Cast Tidal Wave
detail: You conjure up a wave of water that crashes down on an area within range.

title: Cast Time Stop
detail: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself.

title: Cast Tiny Servant
detail: You touch one Tiny, nonmagical object that isn't attached to another object or a surface and isn't being carried by another creature.

title: Cast Toll the Dead
detail: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment.

title: Cast Tongues
detail: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears.

title: Cast Transmute Rock
detail: You choose an area of stone or mud that you can see that fits within a 40-foot cube and is within range, and choose one of the following effects.

title: Cast Transparency
detail: You temporarily become invisible to stop yourself from being discovered by the triggering creature.

title: Cast Transport via Plants
